title: Reachable Drop Configurations
statement: For a Boolean mode and Boolean history $h$, define the reachable configurations to be those reachable for the drop machine using the drop oracle, subject to the good-configuration condition for that mode and history.
caveat: The reachability relation, oracle-machine semantics, and good-configuration predicate are not defined in the supplied statement.
